rootCauses.CX-F-048: CpfProviderBrokerPublisher correctly needs the full persisted headers for inbound Context restoration, but it also copies those CPF-owned headers into the provider user-header request; the router then correctly rejects them as reserved overrides
rootCauses.CX-F-049: Two worker fixtures implement only legacy unfenced mutation methods while Production intentionally requires supportsFenced* plus worker-id overloads
rootCauses.CX-F-050: The QA reconcile test calls deprecated two-argument markPublished instead of completing the claimed UNKNOWN row with worker identity
rootCauses.CX-F-051: The duplicate mock expects message/idempotency only, but default delegation now inserts CPF_DEFAULT_CONSUMER/message/idempotency

fixBoundaries: Use full headers only to restore Context, and remove exactly CpfMessageHeaderNames.ALL from provider user headers
Keep any other reserved provider header subject to fail-close validation
Make test ports explicitly fenced and assert worker-specific overload use
Retain Production legacy-overload rejection and SQL claim fencing
